## Modeling Questions

- What explicit features are you analyzing?

\vspace{8em}

- How do you convert these features to numerical estimates? \vspace{8em}

- How do you resolve differences in opinion among group members?

\vspace{8em}

## Definitional Questions

- Is the activity supervised or unsupervised? \vspace{2em}

- Does it represent a classification or regression problem? \vspace{2em}

- Are you interested primarily in prediction or inference? \vspace{2em}

- Are you using parametric or non-parametric methods?

\newpage

## Conceptual Questions

- What are some sources of "error" in your estimates? \vspace{8em}

- How can we quantify the error in your estimates? \vspace{8em}

- How should we assess the overall accuracy of a group's predictions? \vspace{8em}

- In what other circumstances do people (or companies, or algorithms) predict age based on photos or physical appearance? Is that ethical?
